title: Pattern Remediation Report
description: Report documenting automated remediation attempts for detected anti-patterns

generatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when remediation was executed

whatIf.description: Whether this was a dry-run (no files modified)

severity.description: Severity threshold used for filtering issues

patternIds.description: Optional list of specific pattern IDs targeted for remediation

totalIssues.description: Total number of issues attempted to remediate

issuesFixed.description: Number of issues successfully remediated (at least one file fixed)

issuesSkipped.description: Number of issues skipped (no automatic remediation available or applicable)

issuesFailed.description: Number of issues where remediation failed with errors

results.description: Detailed results for each issue remediation attempt

filesAttempted.description: Number of files where remediation was attempted

filesSkipped.description: Number of files skipped (wildcard patterns or not applicable)

recommendation.description: Manual remediation recommendation if automatic fix not available

metadata.description: Additional metadata about the remediation run

branch.description: Git branch where remediation was executed

executor.description: User or system that executed remediation

catalogVersion.description: Version of the pattern catalog used
